Implement the following requested change in the repository.

# Experiment run with dry=True doesn't work correctly

When running an experiment with the dry option, the experiment is still being created instead of just simulating the run.

```python
import dvc.api

# Create a DVC project and stage
# ...

# This should only simulate the experiment but actually creates it
dvc.experiments.run(stage_name, dry=True)

# Check experiments - should be empty but contains the experiment
experiments = dvc.experiments.ls()
print(experiments)  # Shows the experiment that should not exist
```

This works in version 2.x but not in the latest version. The dry run option should only simulate the experiment without actually creating it.
